findings.title: BCMA is the most crowded target in the myeloma cell-therapy landscape.
findings.statement: 210 of 268 (78%) active clinical programs are BCMA-directed. Five products approved.

findings.title: 15% of recent field failures fall in the construct-level slice a binder-maturation platform acts on.
findings.statement: Of 34 programs terminated, withdrawn, or publicly deprioritized 2019 through 2025: 20 (59%) recorded strategic/corporate reasons as stated in registry/press language (not established commercial-pressure causation); 5 (15%) fall in the construct-level slice a binder-maturation platform acts on.

findings.title: The efficacy bar: cilta-cel 34.9 mo median PFS; approved TCE class 7.5-11.3 mo.
findings.statement: KM reconstructions across seven arms in four pivotal trials, all passing validation thresholds.

findings.title: The approved class is still generating labeled events six years in.
findings.statement: Teclistamab post-2025Q1: IgA nephropathy (n=36), IVth-nerve paralysis (n=31). 17,540 unique FAERS cases across seven products.

findings.title: Sequence-identity screen vs Celyad WO2020221873; identity vs the claimed CDRs tops out at 47%.
findings.statement: Max identity vs Celyad's CLAIMED CDRs is 47%. Six hits exceed 80% on the shorter-sequence metric (fewer on aligned length), all CDR2-vs-CDR2 and against an unclaimed comparator, in the one window whose numbering could not be reliably reproduced. No inventorship comparison is made here.

findings.title: Completed allotments through Nov 2022 (3 SH01); three later allotment authorities, none filed as completed.
findings.statement: Companies House: 3 SH01 completed allotments through Nov 2022; RES10 + RES11 authorities taken 2023-01, 2023-09, 2025-11 with no SH01 since. Resulting-capital figures are nominal, not valuations.

findings.title: The one public technical disclosure covers monomer VHH-CAR CDR3 maturation with a reporter-cell readout.
findings.statement: NeurIPS 2024 workshop preprint. No primary T-cell functional data. No multispecific geometry.

findings.title: The CB-101 multispecific program appears in exactly one venue searched.
findings.statement: One conference speaker-bio attribution. No corroboration across seven venues.

sources_list: Conference abstracts (ASH, ASCO, EHA, SITC, AACR)
